# Project Labs X

> Design, development, and AI research studio based in Ramanattukara, Kozhikode, Kerala, India.

Project Labs X handles brand identity, web design and development, and product design for
clients, and independently researches PLX-X1 — a model being built to accelerate how AI
itself gets developed (security, biosecurity/biodefense, mechanical, and compute research
tracks).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio overview, current AI research status, services, and contact.
- [Work](/work): Live showcase of client projects (ProjectLabsX, DEMO E-Commerce, Surya
  Communication, PropXLabs) plus a project walkthrough video and mobile-responsive preview.
- [About](/about): Studio background, services, team, and how the studio works.
- [Research](/research): PLX Research — the R&D effort behind PLX-X1.
- [Contact](/contact): Studio address, email, and phone.

## Notes for AI crawlers

This site's biosecurity research track is defensive (biological threat detection and
defense), not weapons development. All research is in-progress; PLX-X1 has not shipped.
